title: CommandEnvelope
description:
A command submission from a client (`ROADMAP.md` §9.1).

The client supplies only intent: an operation, an idempotency key, an optional
expected aggregate version for optimistic concurrency, an opaque `body`, and a
correlation context. Authoritative fields — actor, tenant, sequence, timestamps,
authority — are absent from this type and are rejected by `deny_unknown_fields` if a
client tries to send them.

authority_context.description:
The delegation context (`.1.4.2`, ADR-009 — chain-in-envelope): present
when the authenticated actor acts ON BEHALF OF another principal whose
grant is the authority source.

body.description: Operation-specific payload, interpreted by the owning aggregate (§8.6).

expected_aggregate_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency hint: the aggregate version the client believes is current.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated idempotency key; opaque, no prefix (`ROADMAP.md` §9.2).

operation.description: Operation name, e.g. `"thread.create"`. The full operation catalogue is backlog 6.

AuthorityContext.description:
The delegation context a command may carry (`.1.4.2`, ADR-009). The subject
retains its established STRING field (`rol_…`/`hpr_…`). The core
`GrantSubject` kind/id object is a separate authority-payload representation.

on_behalf_of.description: The principal the actor acts on behalf of (the grant holder).

purpose.description: Why (audit context; the authorization record carries it).

scope.description:
The scope the delegation may touch — the request's target must be
within it (the §16.3 widening invariant measures against it).

ClientContext.description: Correlation context a client may attach to a command (`ROADMAP.md` §9.1).

TargetSelector.description:
Which resources a grant's actions reach: everything in the tenant, or a named
thread set.

oneOf.description:
(Struct-like on purpose: serde's tagged representation cannot carry a
newtype variant wrapping a sequence.)
